text: Let us recap. Copper comes from copper pyrite by flotation, roasting, smelting to matte, and auto reduction in the Bessemer converter, then electrolytic refining. Blue vitriol loses its water in stages and its solution gives a famous set of tests. Zinc is reduced as a vapour and is amphoteric. Mercury needs only roasting, and its two chlorides are opposites. Iron is made in the blast furnace and refined to steel, and it rusts electrochemically, which is why galvanising beats tinning. And silver is extracted by the cyanide process, with its nitrate and chloride as key compounds.
